print(len(data))

def parse(data, depth=0, offset=0):
    i = offset
    while i < len(data):
        tag = data[i]
        i += 1
        # length
        l = data[i]
        i += 1
        if l & 0x80:
            n = l & 0x7f
            l = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+n],'big')
            i += n
        start = i
        end = i + l
        content = data[start:end]
        tagstr = f"0x{tag:02x}"
        if tag == 0x30: tagstr="SEQ"
        elif tag == 0x31: tagstr="SET"
        elif tag == 0x02: tagstr="INT"
        elif tag == 0x04: tagstr="OCTET"
        elif tag == 0x06: tagstr="OID"
        elif tag == 0x0c: tagstr="UTF8"
        elif tag == 0x13: tagstr="PRINT"
        elif tag == 0x05: tagstr="NULL"
        elif tag == 0xa0: tagstr="CTX0"
        elif tag == 0xa1: tagstr="CTX1"
        elif tag == 0xa2: tagstr="CTX2"
        elif tag == 0xa3: tagstr="CTX3"
        print("  "*depth + f"[{start-2}-{end}] {tagstr} len={l}")
        if tag in (0x30,0x31,0xa0,0xa1,0xa2,0xa3):
            parse(data, depth+1, start)
        elif tag == 0x02:
            print("  "*(depth+1) + "INT value =", int.from_bytes(content,'big'))
        elif tag == 0x06:
            print("  "*(depth+1) + "OID =", '.'.join(str(x) for x in content))
        i = end
    return

parse(data)
